title: EchoTik Raises Multi-Ten-Million RMB Angel from Yang Jinhe & Internet Execs
summary: On May 4, 2023, ecommerce data SaaS EchoTik / Yike Tech closed a multi-ten-million RMB angel from Purple Bird Secure Browser founder Yang Jinhe and senior internet-company executives. Use of funds: R&D, big-data capability, overseas user research, AGI × cross-border SaaS.
author: Unique Research
html:
Unique Research · Company / funding · May 19, 2023

On May 4, 2023, ecommerce data SaaS EchoTik / Yike Tech closed a multi-ten-million RMB angel from Purple Bird Secure Browser founder Yang Jinhe and senior internet-company executives. Use of funds: R&D, big-data capability, overseas user research, AGI × cross-border SaaS.

Founded Aug 2022 by Singapore startup EchoSell — independent third-party ecommerce data platform for overseas SaaS: collect/clean/integrate/mine → real-time monitoring, category research, traffic/sales analytics, trend charts. Core team from Xiaomi with multi-scenario ecommerce ops depth.

China “Business Advisor (生意参谋)” pattern validated; TikTok sellers need potential-SKU follow; brands need creator match; creators need hot content — EchoTik serves sellers, creators, MCNs, brands for selection / influencer / creative discovery. Export China ecommerce-service know-how to EU/US and SEA.

— END —
